# laravelforge_teams (Resource)

Create a new team for the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_teams" "example" {
  name         = "example-name"
  organization = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `organization` (String) The organization slug

### Optional

- `invites` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))
- `team` (Number) The team ID
- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_teams.example my-org/123
```
